title: Still Episode (fixture za still kadrove)

characters.name: Hanno
characters.locked_description: a lean Carthaginian clerk of about fifty, close-cropped grey hair, a short curled beard, an undyed linen tunic belted with rope, a wax tablet under one arm

locations.name: The Carthage quay
locations.locked_description: a long stone quay of fitted limestone blocks, its edge worn round by rope, crates and amphorae stacked along it, moored hulls riding low in green harbour water

locations.name: The counting house
locations.locked_description: a low vaulted room of whitewashed stone with a beaten earth floor, rows of sealed clay jars on plank shelves, a single high window, ledger scrolls stacked in wooden pigeonholes along one wall

key_props.name: The wax tablet
key_props.locked_description: a hinged wooden writing tablet the size of two palms, its recessed panels filled with dark beeswax, the surface scored by columns of tally marks and thumbed smooth at the edges

notes: Fixture za still kadrove (schemas.md §3.3.2), ne prava epizoda. Šest shotova: pet still sa svih pet pokreta, jedan clip — dokaz da se režimi mešaju u istoj epizodi. Entiteti su isti kao u good-episode namerno: fixture porodica deli kanon, pa se razlika između fixture-a svede na ono što svaki od njih meri. Prolazi BLOCKING sa nula nalaza.
